descriptions.notStarted: Mrs. Reade, who is in charge of keeping The Nautilus clean, says she's worried about the sanitary conditions of the ship because there has been a huge influx of mice on The Nautilus since the ship has been docked at Victoria Island. Should I help Mrs. Reade get rid of the mice?
descriptions.inProgress: The Nautilus has been docked at Victoria Island for some time now, and apparently that causes more rats to board the ship. Mrs. Reade is hyper-anxious having had to deal with all the vermin. I think I'll bring her 50 #bRat Traps#k. I've heard that I could buy mouse traps from the Roches in Ludibrium... \n\n#i4000095##t4000095# #b#c4000095##k / 50
descriptions.completed: We set up 50 mouse traps. I don't think we'll see any more mice around here... would we?
